integrity: Explicit analytic proof with standalone 4215-check diagnostic; historical priority is provisional against incompletely accessible older inverse-problem full texts. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Free-line one-dimensional instantaneous pulse, homogeneous ADR coefficients, positive mass/dispersion/drift and nonnegative first-order decay, exact calibrated sensors and noiseless clocks; upstream restriction applies only to two-monitor inverse. No noisy-data or finite-domain stability theorem.
title: Two-versus-three monitor identifiability and calibrated-mass aliasing for an impulsive river tracer
